title: Tokenized stocks surpass $1B as Ondo, xStocks dominate sector
summary: Foresight Ventures says regulatory barriers and liquidity advantages are driving consolidation in tokenized equities as the market expands.

title: Thailand crypto platforms freeze 10K accounts in AML crackdown: Report
summary: Thai crypto operators reportedly froze 10,000 suspected “mule accounts” as new AML checks and transfer delays took effect in a wider anti-fraud push.

title: US Bitcoin ETFs add $167M as altcoin funds extend outflows
summary: US Bitcoin ETFs added $167 million in inflows on Monday, while Ether, XRP and Solana funds saw three-day outflows despite a crypto market rebound.

title: Blackstone-owned AirTrunk secures record $1.24B loan for Tokyo AI data center
summary: A consortium of 12 banks, led by SMBC, MUFG, Crédit Agricole CIB and Société Générale, arranged the record financing for AirTrunk’s Tokyo data center expansion.

title: Tron joins Agentic AI Foundation as founder sees future in AI
summary: Tron joined the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation to help develop open infrastructure for AI agents alongside members including Circle and JPMorgan.

title: Bhutan moves $11.8M in BTC from its national stash: Arkham
summary: Bhutan has accumulated around 13,000 Bitcoin since launching state-backed mining operations in 2019, primarily fueled by hydroelectric energy.

title: Vitalik Buterin envisions ‘one-click’ Ether staking for institutions
summary: “We want the authority over staking nodes to be highly distributed, and the first step to doing this is to make it easy,” said Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin.

title: US prosecutors seek Roman Storm retrial after mixed verdict
summary: Manhattan US Attorney Jay Clayton asked a judge to schedule a retrial in October for Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm on two charges where the jury failed to reach a verdict.

title: Wall Street funneled $540M into US Solana ETFs in Q4: Bloomberg
summary: Investment advisors were the biggest buyers of the US-based spot Solana ETFs at over $270 million, while hedge fund managers came in next at $186 million.

title: Sharplink reports $735M loss in 2025 as Ethereum slumped
summary: Sharplink says it will continue to acquire Ether despite a brutal crypto market sell-off last year that led to a $616.2 million paper loss on its ETH holdings.
